patch.description:
Update a mutable subset of an existing order. Honours the same sync
contract as POST (15s saga wait + 504 with `operation_id` on
timeout). `Idempotency-Key` is optional (I2266) — if omitted, the
server generates one and echoes it back for polling.

Changing `line_items` re-derives which provider supplies the order.
If that resolves to a **different** provider, the update is refused
with **400** and a `failure.code` you can branch on:

- `SUPPLIER_TAX_DATA_MISSING` — the new provider has no approved tax
  details, so the order could not be invoiced. Permanent until that
  provider completes their tax verification; do not retry blindly.
- `SUPPLIER_TAX_DATA_UNAVAILABLE` — the check could not be made right
  now. Transient: retry.

Nothing is written in either case — the order is left exactly as it
was, provider included.

### Editing a pack

A **pack** is a product sold as a set of other products (e.g. a
"Summer pack" with 2 t-shirts and 1 cap). In an order it is **one
line** with `variant_type: BUNDLE`, and `GET /dropshipper/orders/{id}`
lists its content in that line's `sub_order_line_items`. You can change that
content per order: which products the pack carries and how many
units of each. The catalog pack is not modified.

**Two quantities, do not mix them up:**

- `line_items[].quantity` — the **number of packs**.
- `line_items[].sub_order_line_items[].quantity` — the **units of that
  product inside ONE pack**.

Units shipped of a sub line = line `quantity` × sub line `quantity`.
Example: 3 packs × 2 t-shirts per pack = **6 t-shirts**.

**What `sub_order_line_items` means on a pack line:**

| You send | Result |
|----------|--------|
| `sub_order_line_items` omitted | The pack keeps the composition it has on this order right now (including any earlier edit). |
| `sub_order_line_items` present | It **replaces the whole composition** with exactly the list you send. |
| Change one product's units | Resend **all** sub order line items, with the new `quantity` on that one. |
| Add a product | Include it in the list together with the existing ones. |
| Remove a product | Leave it out of the list. |

`line_items` itself **replaces the whole set of lines** of the order,
so the pack line must always be sent — with or without `sub_order_line_items` —
together with every other line you want to keep. A line you leave out
is removed from the order.

**Restrictions:**

- `sub_order_line_items` is only accepted on a pack line (`variant_type: BUNDLE`).
- At least 1 sub order line item.
- Each sub line `quantity` is a whole number ≥ 1.
- The same `variant_id` cannot appear twice in one pack.
- A sub order line item cannot itself be a pack.
- Every sub order line item must belong to the **same supplier** and have the
  **same fulfillment type** as the rest of the order.
- Only while the order is editable (`DRAFT` or `PENDING`). In
  `ERROR.CARRIER_VALIDATION_FAILED` only the shipping address can be
  changed.
- `POST /dropshipper/orders` does not accept `sub_order_line_items`: a pack is
  created with its catalog composition and adjusted afterwards here.

**Effects of changing the composition:**

- The pack cost for the supplier is recalculated from the new
  composition, and with it the order costs (`expenses_breakdown`) and
  the supplier payout.
- The order weight is recalculated.
- Reserved stock follows the new composition (units no longer needed
  are released, new units are reserved).
- `unit_price` does **not** change by itself: it is the price your
  customer pays for one pack, and only changes if you send a new one.
- The minimum price control applies to the resulting order: an unpaid
  order (`COD` / `MANUAL`) whose total is below the wholesale cost of
  everything it now carries is rejected with `ORDER_TOTAL_BELOW_COST`.

**Recommended flow:**

1. `GET /dropshipper/orders/{id}`.
2. Take every line; on the `BUNDLE` line keep its `sub_order_line_items`,
   sending only `variant_id` and `quantity` for each.
3. Modify the sub order line items (units, add, remove).
4. `PATCH /dropshipper/orders/{id}` with **all** the lines.

The response is the updated order: the pack line shows its new
`sub_order_line_items`. The change is also delivered as an
`order.status.changed` webhook.

**Errors (400) when editing a pack** — branch on `failure.code`:

| `failure.code` | When | `failure.message` | How to fix |
|----------------|------|-------------------|------------|
| `PACK_COMPONENTS_NOT_A_PACK` | `sub_order_line_items` sent on a line that is not a pack | `Components can only be set on a pack line` | Remove `sub_order_line_items` from that line. |
| `PACK_COMPONENTS_INVALID` | `sub_order_line_items` is not an array | `line_items[0].sub_order_line_items must be an array of { variant_id, quantity }` | Send an array of `{ variant_id, quantity }`. |
| `PACK_COMPONENTS_EMPTY` | `sub_order_line_items` is `[]` | `line_items[0].sub_order_line_items must contain at least one sub order line item. Omit sub_order_line_items to keep the pack's current composition` | Send at least one sub order line item, or omit `sub_order_line_items`. |
| `PACK_COMPONENT_INVALID_VARIANT_ID` | A sub line `variant_id` is missing or not an integer ≥ 1 | `line_items[0].sub_order_line_items[1].variant_id must be a positive integer (variant_number)` | Use the product's `variant_id` from the order or the catalog. |
| `PACK_COMPONENT_INVALID_QUANTITY` | A sub line `quantity` is missing, 0, negative or decimal | `line_items[0].sub_order_line_items[1].quantity must be a positive integer (units of this item per pack unit)` | Send a whole number ≥ 1 (units per ONE pack). |
| `PACK_COMPONENT_DUPLICATED` | The same `variant_id` twice in one pack | `line_items[0].sub_order_line_items contains variant_id 111 more than once` | Send each product once, with its total units per pack. |
| `PACK_COMPONENT_UNSUPPORTED_FIELD` | A sub order line item carries a field other than `variant_id` / `quantity` | `line_items[0].sub_order_line_items[0] contains unsupported field(s): unit_price. Each sub order line item only accepts variant_id and quantity.` | Send only `variant_id` and `quantity`. |
| `PACK_COMPONENT_NOT_FOUND` | A sub line `variant_id` does not exist | `line_items[0].sub_order_line_items[1].variant_id 999 not found` | Check the variant number in `GET /dropshipper/products`. |
| `PACK_COMPONENT_IS_PACK` | A sub order line item is itself a pack | `A pack component cannot be a pack itself` | Use the products of that pack, not the pack. |
| `MIXED_SUPPLIERS` | A sub order line item (or line) belongs to another supplier | `all products of the order must belong to the same supplier` | Use products of the order's supplier only. |
| `PACK_COMPONENT_PROVIDER_MISMATCH` | Same as above, detected while applying the edit | `A pack component belongs to a different provider than the rest of the order` | Same as above. |
| `MIXED_FULFILLMENT_TYPES` | A sub order line item (or line) has another fulfillment type | `all products must have the same fulfillment type. cannot mix PROVIDER and DROPEA products in a single order.` | Use products with the order's fulfillment type only. |
| `INVALID_ORDER_STATE` | The order is no longer editable | `Order cannot be edited in CONFIRMED status. Only DRAFT, PENDING, or ERROR.CARRIER_VALIDATION_FAILED orders can be edited.` | The order can no longer be edited; cancel and re-create it if needed. |
| `ERROR_EDIT_SCOPE_VIOLATION` | Lines sent while the order is in `ERROR.CARRIER_VALIDATION_FAILED` | `Items cannot be edited while order is in ERROR.CARRIER_VALIDATION_FAILED` | Only send `customer_details` in that state. |
| `ORDER_TOTAL_BELOW_COST` | Unpaid order whose total no longer covers the wholesale cost | `Order total 20 is below the wholesale cost 24.5 of its items` | Raise `unit_price`, or reduce the sub order line items. |

Branch on `failure.code`, not on the message text.

post.summary: Link a Dropea product to a shop
post.description:
Link a Dropea product to the merchant's shop. The endpoint is
shop-agnostic: it resolves the shop and dispatches by `store_type`.

- **SHOPIFY**: `external_product_id` and `variant_mapping` are
  required. Each mapping either LINKs the Dropea variant to an
  existing Shopify variant (`action=LINK`, `external_variant_id`
  required — its SKU and price are overwritten with the Dropea
  values) or CREATEs a new Shopify variant (`action=CREATE`). The
  external ids are the Shopify GraphQL gids (`gid://shopify/Product/...`,
  `gid://shopify/ProductVariant/...`).
- **GENERIC**: only `product_id` and the `variant_id`s of the
  `variant_mapping` are used (the `action` / external ids are
  ignored). The Dropea product + variants are associated to the shop.
- **WOOCOMMERCE / UNKNOWN**: `422 STORE_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED`.

The Dropea product and variants are referenced by their public
sequential numbers; they are resolved to internal ids BEFORE any saga
is fired (unknown numbers return 404/400 with no side effect).

Asynchronous: a settled saga returns 201 with the created
associations; if it does not settle within the budget the response
is 504 with an `operation_id` to poll. `Idempotency-Key` is optional
(I2266) — if omitted, the server generates one and echoes it back.

it does not settle within the budget the response is 504 with an

put.description:
Turn the synchronization between Dropea and a Shopify shop on or off.
While it is off nothing goes in or out: Shopify orders are not
imported (neither automatically nor with the «Send to Dropea» button),
and Dropea sends no stock, products, shop info, fulfillments nor order
notes to the shop. Nothing is notified to Shopify. Turning it back on

imported by themselves.

operation id.

  Shopify subscriptions could not be updated; repeating the request
  is safe.
- `504`: the change did not complete in time; poll
  `GET /operations/{operation_id}`.
